race.comment: DISCREET POINT (3) is back from a break of six-and-a-half months and now in the Matt Dunn yard. Showed ability in Victoria and wasn't knocked about in the two trials. Can finish over the top of these. DIAMANTINA ROSE (1) returned from a let-up with a game on pace third over 800m at Ipswich in BM78 class. Claim helps from the good gate and expected to be in the finish. KIRRA'S SISTER (7) indicated a win was imminent when taken to the front for a fighting second over 1015m at Grafton. Maps well and looks a leading contender. COOL FIZZ (2) faded late with the 61kg from the wide gate to finish eighth over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Assess on the good run two back. THE ROOKIE (6) has a good record at this track and trip and stays in the mix.
